### A Cycle of Sin
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-7-2024.html
Passage: Genesis 20:2
Points:
- Spiritual maturity is a gradual process, and believers never reach sinless perfection in this earthly life.
- Even great heroes of faith like Abraham can stumble back into old habits and repeat sins out of fear.
- Abraham's dishonest scheme backfired, yet God still stepped in to reveal Himself to a foreign king.
- Believers who fall can return to God in repentance, confident that He will continue to use them.

### God’s Plans for Us Stand
Author: Michael A. Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-january-23-2026.html
Passage: Genesis 20:1-2
Points:
- The Christian life of faith involves ongoing growth that often includes setbacks and moments of weakness.
- Facing a foreign ruler, Abraham gave in to fear and repeated his earlier sin of deceit.
- Human lapses in faith cannot overturn the sovereign purpose and overarching plan of God.
- God graciously safeguarded Sarah and Abraham, remaining faithful to fulfill His covenant promise.

### God Comes to Abimelech
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-comes-abimelech
Passage: Genesis 20:2-7
Points:
- God spoke directly to Abimelech in a dream, warning him of judgment for taking another man's wife.
- Abimelech appealed to the Lord's justice, emphasizing his ignorance and the integrity of his heart.
- God affirmed the king's sincerity and revealed that His providence had restrained Abimelech from touching Sarah.
- The Lord watches over and guards the way of those who seek to walk in uprightness.
